g.title: BULKHEAD_CABIN
g.text: Cabin side — permanent. Deutsch p/n AS616-79PN or Souriau 8STA79PN equiv.
AC enable signal (MaxxECU GPO → AC relay coil) [see power-distribution.wv]
APS GND 1 (E46 pedal pin 1 → MaxxECU SGND)
APS GND 2 (E46 pedal pin 2 → MaxxECU SGND)
APS1 signal (pedal pin 4 → MaxxECU APS1 AIN)
APS2 signal (pedal pin 6 → MaxxECU APS2 AIN)

Cabin side is permanent. Engine-side mating plug (Deutsch AS79 jam nut plug) is per-harness: M52 harness Phase 1, 07K harness Phase 3 (same pin numbers → plug-and-play swap). EXCEPTION — pins 72-77 (APS e-pedal): cavity-plugged in Phase 1; the cabin-side cable run from the E46 pedal module to the bulkhead face is the ONE cabin-side harness addition performed at the M52 → 07K swap. Engine-side of 72-77 wires into the 07K mating plug (to MaxxECU APS1/APS2 CMC pins). AS79 contact sizes: Size 12 (23A) for power/GND, Size 20 (7.5A) for signals. Souriau 8STA Size 8 contacts (45A) available for AC relay output pin 7 if needed. 120Ω CAN terminator: one end at MaxxECU (cabin side); one end at 8HP TCU (engine bay). 120Ω at firewall bulkhead pins 47/48 ONLY if 8HP is stub-terminated here (not recommended).

g.title: W_BULKHEAD
g.text: BULKHEAD_ENGINE_M52:1:+12V Coils/Inj → engine harness common rail
BULKHEAD_ENGINE_M52:22:Crank VR+ → M52 crank sensor pin 1
BULKHEAD_ENGINE_M52:23:Crank VR- → M52 crank sensor pin 2
BULKHEAD_CABIN:52:AC enable signal (MaxxECU GPO → AC relay coil) [see power-distribution.wv]

CAN H/L (pins 47-48) must be twisted pair, 120ohm termination at MaxxECU end (cabin) and at 8HP TCU end (engine bay). DCTShifter and Gauge.S tap cabin-side CAN bus before the bulkhead — no additional bulkhead pins required for either device. WBO2 Heater+ (LSU 4.9 pin 4) connects to engine bay +12V coil/inj rail (pin 1) via local splice — no separate bulkhead pin needed. Crank VR+/VR-/Shield (pins 22-24) should be shielded twisted pair; shield terminates at cabin-side sensor GND (CMC H1), floating at engine-side.

g.title: BULKHEAD_ENGINE_M52
g.text: Deutsch AS79 / Souriau 8STA 79-way jam nut plug
Engine side — M52 Phase 1 harness. Unplugs at swap.
Crank VR+ → M52 crank sensor pin 1
Crank VR- → M52 crank sensor pin 2

M52 Phase 1 engine-side mating plug. Stubs on pins 54-71 are sealed with Deutsch cavity plugs. Pins 72-77 are also cavity-plugged on M52 — they become APS1/APS2 e-pedal pass-through on the 07K mating plug (Phase 3). Pin assignments 1-53 are identical between M52 and 07K harnesses; the cabin-side cable (pedal run, pins 72-77) is the ONE cabin-side addition at the swap. See maxxecu-07k.wv and epedal-bmw-e46.wv for full routing.
